name: opencode-control
description: Deep control of the OpenCode AI coding agent (sst/anomalyco opencode). Two connectors: the HTTP server (`opencode serve`) reached through a full ~162-operation passthrough plus ~30 curated tools (status, sessions, prompt, agents, commands, skills, models/providers, config, MCP, files/find, VCS, TUI control, events), AND an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) connector that drives `opencode acp` over JSON-RPC/stdio to run prompts as an agent from anywhere. Plus on-disk authoring of agents, commands and skills, and a control skill covering configuration, optimization, and agent/workflow design.
